question: Can a non-degenerate ASYMMETRIC-DISCOVERY task bank (ADB-v7) be certified ARITHMETICALLY in DESIGN before freeze - the cold re-derivation baseline (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE) and the retrieval-shaped comparator (B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED) provably below the success ceiling (point < 0.95 AND two-sided 95% Wilson high < the session-amortizing treatment's low) on the high-novelty stratum, the treatment (T-AMORT-REUSE) behaviourally distinct and live, a foreknown-schema positive control (PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA) solvable, all four mandate counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) reconciling exactly to the server log, and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate CALIBRATED against a same-transport KNOWN-DEGENERATE calibration class (CC-DEGENERATE) so the certificate demonstrably returns FALSE on a class whose comparators sit at the ceiling - and be delivered as a reusable Runtime substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (blocker B2)? This is an instrument/certificate experiment, NOT a re-run of the symmetric mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class already shown degenerate (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064, EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598: cold/retrieval success 1.0 at n>=0.5). If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate class tested, DESIGN records a bounded substrate-class negative and does NOT freeze.
hypothesis: A credential-free deterministic localhost REST bank is a certified non-degenerate instrument for the flagship inheritance benchmark iff its discovery structure is a SESSION-SCOPED CARRY CHAIN such that (a) each session begins with a fixed bootstrap (root, hub, boot/1..5 = 7 requests; /boot/5 serves the session manifest with the ordered role registry and task list) and each required role is resolved by a fixed 3-step chained protocol GET /disc/<role>/<step> whose each step requires the previous step's value, so no policy can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests per task without persisting the resolved token across tasks; (b) the hidden-role count grows with novelty as h(n)=8n for n in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75}; (c) the task specification is handed to every arm as the task input uniformly (not an HTTP request); (d) the published per-task integer HTTP budget B(n)={11,15,16,18} is non-decreasing and lenient toward the comparators; and (e) the SAME certificate predicate is calibrated against a same-transport calibration class CC-DEGENERATE whose discovery is QUERY-ANSWERABLE (1 request per role, no carry) and whose budget B_deg(n)={11,13,15,17} is deliberately generous. Under these frozen declarations the arithmetic predicts: on ADB-v7, cold nominal server cost 7+3h+1={8,14,20,26} and retrieval nominal server cost 5+3h+1={6,12,18,24} (total including 3 local index probes ={9,15,21,27}) exceed B(n) at high novelty (n>=0.5) while treatment per-task http {9,7,7,7} and PC h+8={8,10,12,14} fit every level, giving high-novelty success cold 0/12, retrieval 0/12, treatment 12/12, PC 12/12 with non-overlapping Wilson intervals (comparator k<=6 high <= 0.7462 < treatment lo 0.7575); on CC-DEGENERATE cold 8+h={8,10,12,14} and retrieval total 9+h={9,11,13,15} fit B_deg at every level, so both comparators reach the ceiling and the SAME certificate predicate returns FALSE. The certificate therefore has observable dynamic range rather than being a constant-TRUE oracle. If the carry-chain asymmetric construction does NOT produce this separation on the credential-free class, the flagship benchmark must not be funded on this bank class.
falsifier: The ADB-v7 bank-readiness hypothesis is falsified or bounded by any of: (F1) on ADB-v7 at least one comparator (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE or B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED) reaches the ceiling or its high-novelty Wilson 95% interval is not disjoint below the treatment's (observed point >= 0.95, or interval overlap, e.g. comparator high-novelty k >= 7 of 12) while PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA succeeds and every integrity gate holds - the bank has no certified dynamic range; (F2) the DESIGN arithmetic certificate shows a high-novelty stratum empty, a predicted success cell unreachable, or a budget that admits a comparator at high novelty (caught before freeze, not a runtime discovery); (F3) the treatment is not live at HIGH novelty - it fails a high-novelty task, its per-task cost exceeds B(n), or the observed comparator-minus-treatment total gap is not non-decreasing across n or its high-novelty minimum is < 8 requests (a treatment failure at LOW novelty n<0.5, or a session whose declared sequence is not the frozen ascending warm-up, is integrity gate I9 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, an instrument failure, not a scientific negative); (F4) any integrity gate I1..I11 fails (PC < 24/24, out-of-support session accepted, budget-truncation overrun, counter reconciliation non-zero, session replay not exact, rendered declaration/certificate not equal to the embedded declaration/predicted certificate, route-token leak, non-deterministic re-run, contamination, or the CC-DEGENERATE calibration gate I11 failing); (F5) the DESIGN certificate predicate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate class tested, in which case DESIGN records a bounded substrate-class negative and does NOT freeze. F1/F3 map to status=COMPLETE with outcome FALSIFIES or MIXED (a bounded negative about this bank construction). F4 maps to status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (instrument failure, never a scientific negative). F2 is a DESIGN/freeze failure, not a result.

B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.role: strong baseline (first agent, no cross-task inheritance, per-task isolation)
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.description: Stateless per-task episode with no cross-task memory, no retrieval index, no mechanism store and no session state; handed the task spec and the site root URL only, and must follow navigation from root. robots.txt (allow-all) and sitemap.xml (listing only /, /hub, /about) are ordinary routes so the strongest bounded enumeration (sitemap, then hub, then boot/1..5) costs 7 requests, identical to root,hub,boot/1..5; enumeration cannot amortize the boot chain or the manifest. It walks the bootstrap (7), then re-walks the full 3-step /disc chain for each required role (3h), then /verify (1). NOMINAL untruncated per-task cost = 3h(n)+8 = {8,14,20,26}; it fits B(n)={11,15,16,18} only at n in {0,0.25} and strictly exceeds B(n) at n in {0.5,0.75}. Because B(n) is a HARD per-task HTTP budget, an episode that would exceed it halts at exactly B(n) with zero overrun and is scored a failure; the predicted OBSERVED ledger is {8,14,16,18}.
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.procedure: fresh_episode -> bootstrap(root,hub,boot1..5,manifest_at_boot5) -> for each required role: disc(step1),disc(step2),disc(step3) -> verify
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.scope_bound: Deliberately non-omniscient and stateless: the strongest bounded planner given the same published budget as every arm, but forbidden from carrying a resolution receipt across tasks of a session. Because the discovery primitive is a fixed carry chain, no policy can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests per task without cross-task persistence - the exact capability under test. Certifies the instrument under these declared policies; it does not claim these policies are optimal against an unrealized memory-carrying agent (readiness condition 3).

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.description: Like cold, plus 3 local index probes per task against a cross-instance leave-instance-out trajectory index built only from OTHER sessions' trajectories (probes are a local module call counted separately as retrieval_calls, not server http_requests). The index supplies only the static root/hub navigational prefix (so retrieval starts at /boot/1 and spends 5 bootstrap requests), but the boot chain carries and the role-resolution receipts are session-scoped and the index is leave-instance-out, so retrieved fragments cannot supply the current session's carries or role mapping; retrieval still re-walks the full 3-step chain per role per task (3h). Server cost 3h(n)+6={6,12,18,24}; total including the 3 index probes = {9,15,21,27}. It fits B(n) at n in {0,0.25} (server 6,12; total 9,15) and strictly exceeds B(n) at n in {0.5,0.75} (server 18,24; total 21,27). Because B(n) caps HTTP requests only, a truncated high-novelty episode halts at exactly B(n) HTTP and fails: predicted OBSERVED server http {6,12,16,18} and OBSERVED total {9,15,19,21}. The index cost is included in every total.
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.procedure: fresh_episode -> index_top_k(3, leave_instance_out) -> bootstrap(boot1..5,manifest_at_boot5) -> for each required role: disc(step1),disc(step2),disc(step3) -> verify
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.scope_bound: The index is cross-instance and leave-instance-out. Because boot/1..5 and the manifest are session-scoped carry-chain responses, the index can supply only the STATIC root/hub pages; a retrieval advantage would require it to supply the current session's boot carries or role-resolution receipts, which are session-scoped and absent from a leave-instance-out index. Declared limitation, disclosed rather than hidden: because retrieval saves only the fixed 2-request root/hub prefix over cold, its stratum-level success profile coincides with cold (both {T,T,F,F}); the two comparators jointly bracket the ceiling rather than testing independent mechanisms. Both are strictly below the treatment and their ledgers differ (retrieval pays 3 index probes and 1 fewer server request).

treatment.role: session-amortizing mechanism (the Runtime substrate capability under test; declared stand-in for the unshipped Product B1 carrier C-PARAM-INHERIT)
treatment.description: A stateful policy that opens one multi-task session, walks the carry-chained bootstrap once (7) and fetches /tasks (1) = 8 session requests charged to the warm-up task, then resolves the session's tasks in the frozen ascending sequence ['0.0','0.25','0.5','0.75']. The task specification is handed to every arm as the task input and is not an HTTP request for any arm (uniform across arms). It persists the session manifest and, after a role's 3-step /disc chain completes, records that role's resolved token; on later tasks an already-known role costs 0 /disc requests and each newly introduced role costs 3 (roles are nested: level n introduces the first h(n)=8n roles, so 2 new roles per escalating level). It issues /verify (1 per task). Per-task http = [9,7,7,7] for n=0/0.25/0.5/0.75; session total 30; every per-task cost <= B(n). Before spending it validates that the manifest declares the frozen ascending warm-up sequence; if the sequence differs it refuses the session (UNKNOWN, no commit, no verify) rather than overspending.
treatment.procedure: open_session -> validate_manifest_sequence -> bootstrap(root,hub,boot1..5) -> tasks -> spec1 -> [task_k: (spec if k>1) + new_roles*3 + verify]
treatment.scope_bound: The treatment is a declared deterministic Runtime mechanism, not a Product carrier, so the pre-freeze Product-carrier liveness mandate does not apply; its liveness is structural and certified arithmetically (every per-task cost <= B(n)). This instrument does not itself establish the inheritance economics; that is the downstream four-arm benchmark (dependencies C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-LLM-INHERIT are referenced, not tested here).

positive_control.description: A policy given the session manifest, the role registry and the resolved role tokens out of band (zero discovery cost) on the SAME 24 test tasks (all 4 novelty levels), plus the task spec. It walks the bootstrap (7) and issues one commit per required role (h) + /verify (1) = h(n)+8 = {8,10,12,14}, all <= B(n). If the bank is realizable and budgets adequate this must succeed 24/24; failure at any level means the bank is unsolvable and separates 'no headroom because discovery is costly' from 'no headroom because the task is impossible'. It is a SOLVABILITY ceiling control, NOT a headroom comparator, and is excluded from the comparator-minus-treatment gap computation.
positive_control.expected_behavior: success_in_budget = 24/24 across all novelty levels; high-novelty stratum 12/12

null_control.description: Five frozen out-of-support session instances whose manifest schema is not the frozen schema (non-ascending task sequence or a role registry that is not the nested first-h(n) draw). T-AMORT-REUSE validates the session manifest served at /boot/5 and must classify the episode OUT_OF_SUPPORT at that point and refuse (UNKNOWN, no role commits, no /verify) rather than fabricate or fall through to a generic resolver.
null_control.expected_behavior: refusal_rate = 1.0, false_accepts = 0/5, bound_value = null; each refusal emitted at manifest classification after exactly 7 requests (root, hub, boot/1..5), with 0 role commits, 0 /verify calls and 0 /tasks fetches; any episode that commits a role or verifies is a false accept

additional_controls.CC-DEGENERATE: CERTIFICATE-SENSITIVITY calibration class: the SAME localhost transport with a QUERY-ANSWERABLE discovery route GET /answer/<role> (1 request per role, no carry chain) and budget B_deg(n)={11,13,15,17}. The calibration bank is 4 high-novelty tasks (levels {0.5,0.75}, 2 each). Both strong comparators are predicted to fit B_deg (cold at n=0.5,0.75 costs h+8=12,14; retrieval total 13,15, all within B_deg={15,17}) and therefore to reach the ceiling (4/4). The frozen certificate predicate must return FALSE for CC-DEGENERATE while returning TRUE for ADB-v7; if either CC-DEGENERATE comparator is observed BELOW the ceiling the certificate calibration has failed (gate I11 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). This is the control that proves the certificate is not a constant-TRUE oracle and directly encodes the Director mandate's 'unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested' branch.
additional_controls.NC-BUDGET-TRUNCATION: 6 deliberately under-funded episodes distinct from the main matrix: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE at n=0.5 over 6 sessions is given an imposed budget of 10 requests (its nominal policy needs 20), so if the hard-budget enforcement is real every episode halts at exactly 10 with zero overrun and a recorded failure/partial state (gate I3). Any overrun or any episode that reports success is a budget-enforcement failure.
additional_controls.M-COUNTER-RECONCILE: per-episode arm counters must equal the server request log and subset relations must hold; mismatches must be 0 (gate I4).
additional_controls.M-REPAIR-TRANSIENT: one injected transient fault per episode: observed repair_attempts is 1 (charged to http_requests) or an honest failure; no hidden retry.
additional_controls.PC-EXACT-SESSION-REPLAY: 6 replayed treatment test sessions reproduce the original per-route counter vectors exactly (gate I5).

substrate.name: ADB-v7 (Asymmetric-Discovery Bank, v7) with calibration class CC-DEGENERATE
substrate.type: credential-free, locally-served, deterministic multi-page REST substrate with a session-scoped carry-chained role-resolution layer, plus a same-transport query-answerable calibration sibling
substrate.implementation: Python 3.12 standard library only: http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer for the site, urllib.request for arm transport, html.parser + json for parsing, hashlib for content digests, random.Random(SEED) for seeded values. No third-party package, no browser, no external network, no credentials, no cookies, no model calls. The site and arms import no pre-existing Runtime module.
substrate.transport: http on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral OS-chosen port; the port is not part of the frozen declaration identity (declared as the literal string 'ephemeral-not-frozen').

measurement_validity.discovery_protocol: Asymmetric class ADB-v7: per role, resolution is a fixed 3-step carry chain: GET /disc/<role>/1 returns a per-role session nonce N_r; GET /disc/<role>/2/<N_r> returns a partial token P_r iff N_r is the session-valid nonce; GET /disc/<role>/3/<P_r> returns the resolved token T_r and commits role r for the session iff P_r is valid. Each step requires the previous step's value and the chain mixes the role id with the session secret, so it cannot be shortened or shared across roles within a task, and no arm can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests without persisting T_r across tasks. This makes the per-role cost strategy-invariant. The bootstrap is also session-scoped: root and hub are static site-level pages, but boot/1..5 form a session-scoped carry chain and the manifest at /boot/5 is session-scoped, so a cross-instance leave-instance-out index can supply at most the static root/hub content. Calibration class CC-DEGENERATE: per role, resolution is a single GET /answer/<role> returning T_r directly (1 request), so a stateless arm can satisfy the budget without persistence.

task_bank.construction: F=2 families (F1,F2), 3 test sessions per family x 4 tasks (one per novelty level n in {0.0,0.25,0.5,0.75}) = 24 test tasks per arm for ADB-v7; high-novelty stratum n>=0.5 = 12 tasks per arm, low-novelty = 12. Each session's task list is fixed ascending ['0.0','0.25','0.5','0.75'] and each task requires the first h(n)=8n of the session's ordered registry (0,2,4,6 roles). The task spec exposes role names but MUST NOT contain any route token (session id, canonical base, boot/hub/task/disc routes or absolute URLs). The CC-DEGENERATE calibration bank is a single family x 4 high-novelty tasks (n in {0.5,0.75}, 4 tasks) evaluated by both comparators; it is a certificate-calibration control, not a headroom comparator.
task_bank.novelty_definition: novelty n is a declared level of each frozen task; high novelty is n>=0.5, low novelty n<0.5. The h(n)=8n hidden-role count is the operational cost driver, so stratum membership is arithmetic, not EXECUTE discretion.
task_bank.budget_semantics: Per-task integer HARD HTTP-request budget applied identically to every arm. Success = every required role is committed and /verify confirms the committed state within B(n) SERVER (HTTP) requests. The budget caps HTTP requests only: the retrieval arm's 3 local index probes are counted separately as retrieval_calls and are NOT HTTP, so they never consume the HTTP budget (but are always included in the fully-loaded total used for the gap comparison). An episode whose policy would exceed B(n) HALTS at exactly B(n) with zero overrun and is scored a failure. ADB-v7 budgets are non-decreasing and deliberately LENIENT toward the comparators (they do not shrink with novelty), so a comparator failing at high novelty fails despite the allowance. CC-DEGENERATE budgets are deliberately generous so that both comparators are forced to the ceiling, making certificate FALSE the correct prediction.
task_bank.route_leak_rule: Two distinct surfaces, checked statically in DESIGN and re-checked at EXECUTE (gate I7). (i) TASK SPECS (handed to every arm as task input): must contain no session id, no absolute URL, no declared route literal and no token/nonce; they expose only the goal and the role names. (ii) RENDERED SITE PAGES: may carry the declared navigational route templates the arms must follow (this is the intended discovery surface, learnable at the manifest), but must contain no absolute URL, no session id in prose, and no resolved/partial token or nonce outside the single step response that legitimately produces it. robots.txt (allow-all) and sitemap.xml (listing only '/', '/hub' and '/about') are ordinary routes; arms are handed the task spec and the site root URL only, and the strongest enumeration (sitemap + hub + boot/1..5 = 7) costs the same as root + hub + boot/1..5, so enumeration cannot amortize the boot chain or the manifest and cannot introduce an undeclared cost asymmetry.

per_task_counters.http_requests: server-logged HTTP request count for the episode (ground truth); equals bootstrap_requests + tasks_page_requests + discovery_calls + verification_calls on ADB-v7 (and the same with calibration_calls in place of discovery_calls on CC-DEGENERATE)
per_task_counters.bootstrap_requests: exactly-accounted subset of http_requests spent on root/hub/boot navigation (7 for cold/every session-opening arm; 5 for retrieval, which recovers the root/hub prefix from its index)
per_task_counters.tasks_page_requests: exactly-accounted subset of http_requests spent on /tasks (0 for cold/retrieval/PC; 1 per treatment session, charged to the warm-up task)
per_task_counters.discovery_calls: exactly-accounted subset of http_requests spent on the ADB-v7 3-step discovery protocol (3h for stateless arms; new_roles*3 for the treatment)
per_task_counters.calibration_calls: exactly-accounted subset of http_requests spent on the CC-DEGENERATE 1-step /answer route (h per task); 0 on ADB-v7
per_task_counters.retrieval_calls: local index queries issued (0 for cold/treatment/PC; 3 per task for retrieval) - counted SEPARATELY and NOT part of http_requests because the index is an in-process module, and disclosed as such
per_task_counters.repair_attempts: recovery actions issued after a failed discovery/verify, capped at 1 per task; each is charged to http_requests and flagged as a retried request, so repair_attempts is a tagged SUBSET of http_requests (<=1/task), never added on top
per_task_counters.partition_equation: On ADB-v7: http_requests == bootstrap_requests + tasks_page_requests + discovery_calls + verification_calls; on CC-DEGENERATE: http_requests == bootstrap_requests + tasks_page_requests + calibration_calls + verification_calls. This exact partition (with repair_attempts a flagged subset) is what M-COUNTER-RECONCILE / gate I4 enforces.
per_task_counters.excluded: latency_ms and model calls/tokens are prohibited as decision inputs (prior audit found latency_ms/1000 to be instrument noise).

measurement_validity.authorship_separation: The site (ground-truth provider and request-log authority) and the arm policies are separate modules; the site never imports an arm module and no arm may read the site source. The retrieval index is built by a module that cannot read the site source or the evaluated session/family.
measurement_validity.session_scope: Declared per-arm session semantics (frozen in the declaration object): T-AMORT-REUSE = one session per 4-task block (3 sessions per family x 2 families = 6 sessions; roles persist only within a session); B-COLD-RE-DERIVE, B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED and PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA = one fresh per-task episode (24 independent episodes each; no cross-task state); CC-DEGENERATE comparators = per-task episodes on the 4-task calibration bank. For per-task episodes the served session contains exactly the single declared task. This makes the memory asymmetry explicit and prevents an undeclared session-reuse channel.
measurement_validity.counter_honesty: Every arm-reported counter must reconcile exactly to the site request log. Per episode the frozen PARTITION predicate is: arm_reported_http_requests == server_logged_requests AND http_requests == bootstrap_requests + tasks_page_requests + discovery_calls + verification_calls (ADB-v7; calibration_calls replaces discovery_calls on CC-DEGENERATE) AND retrieval_calls is recorded independently of http_requests (never summed into it) AND repair_attempts is a flagged subset of http_requests with repair_attempts <= 1 per task. M-COUNTER-RECONCILE mismatches must be 0 or the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.determinism: All topology, listing order, role ordering, disc values and task banks are generated from the frozen declaration and seed. The EXECUTE-rendered site's canonical topology object (serialized with json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) must equal the declaration embedded verbatim in prereg.md section 5, and the recomputed predicted certificate must equal the certificate embedded in prereg.md section 6 (norm-equal; gate I6). Running the same episode twice must produce identical counters (gate I8). EXECUTE must also write research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38094119952/bank_manifest.json containing a canonical digest of the fully-rendered bank, hash-recorded in provenance.json/result.json.artifacts.
measurement_validity.inference_scope: The ADB-v7 task population is a small deterministic finite bank (24 tasks; 12 per novelty stratum), not a random sample from a population. The Wilson intervals are descriptive summaries over these fixed tasks and are NOT sampling-based confidence intervals; the matched-task design makes the treatment/comparator contrast deterministic given a faithful render. They are used only as the frozen, pre-declared separation criterion, not as an inferential population claim.
measurement_validity.prerequisites: Python 3.12 standard library present (http.server, urllib.request, html.parser, json, hashlib, random, statistics, socket, threading); no browser, no network egress, no credential and no external dataset. A DESIGN stdlib import probe (python 3.12.15, 9 modules) and a localhost ThreadingHTTPServer canary (127.0.0.1:ephemeral, HTTP 200) confirmed both prerequisites. The bank is not an external prerequisite: it is the object under certification, fully specified by the frozen declaration in prereg.md and materialized at EXECUTE inside the experiment transaction; no external site, dataset, credential or model endpoint is read. The retrieval index and the CC-DEGENERATE calibration sibling are in-transaction local modules derived from the same declaration, not external corpora.
measurement_validity.no_synthetic_fallback: Any failure (site bind failure, transport error, digest mismatch) is recorded with the exact error and mapped to MEASUREMENT_INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE, never silently substituted and never encoded as a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.site_authoring_disclosure: The substrate is synthetic by design (no third-party site exhibits exactly this declared asymmetric structure). This experiment certifies the INSTRUMENT's dynamic range and honesty under declared non-omniscient policies; it does not certify transfer to the open Web or to a real LLM agent.
measurement_validity.memory_asymmetry_disclosure: The declared asymmetry between arms is a within-session MEMORY asymmetry, stated openly rather than hidden behind a protocol trick. The discovery protocol is a fixed 3-step carry chain that no policy can shorten; the only way to pay less than 3 per role per task is to persist the resolved token across tasks, which is exactly the declared treatment capability. B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED are declared as the strongest bounded policies consistent with their no-cross-task-persistence constraint. This experiment certifies the instrument under exactly these declared policies; it explicitly does NOT claim a memory-carrying LLM agent (readiness condition 3) is bounded by them.
measurement_validity.prior_bounded_negative: INHERITED ESTABLISHED NEGATIVE (recorded, not re-asked): the SYMMETRIC MANDATORY-DISCOVERY deterministic credential-free REST class is degenerate. EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 (COMPLETE/FALSIFIES) observed cold and retrieval success 1.0 at every novelty level because both arms implement the same mandatory session/resource/endpoint discovery and the deterministic server accepts all in-support values; C1 dynamic-range certificate unsatisfiable; and it recorded a freeze-gate defect (scripts/freeze_experiment.py did not enforce a dynamic_range_certified key). EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 and EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598 hit the same 1.0 ceiling. ADB-v7 is a materially DIFFERENT class (session-scoped asymmetric carry-chain discovery whose cost no stateless policy can amortize) and is the proposed repair of that bounded negative. The bounded-negative finding itself is inherited evidence and is not re-measured here.
measurement_validity.pre2_discipline: Screened against codex/legacy_brief.json: no pre-2.0 asymmetric-discovery / certified-dynamic-range task-bank precedent exists (LEGACY: NO_MATCH for the bank construction). The nearest legacy lesson, P2-REPLAY-COST (source sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b: matched 2.822s cold vs 2.816s replay = 1.002x, with the guard to use matched tasks and fully loaded counterfactuals and not to frame scripted replay as real-agent economics) is applied as a guard: every arm pays fully loaded costs including retrieval probes and repair charges, tasks are matched across arms, and no scripted-replay economics is claimed.

contamination_certificate.isolation: Each arm runs against a fresh server process on a fresh ephemeral port with a fresh in-memory session namespace; no arm shares mutable state with another and server request logs are per-arm.
contamination_certificate.index_isolation: The retrieval index is built only from OTHER sessions' trajectories (leave-instance-out) and MUST NOT contain any route, token or page from the evaluated session or family.
contamination_certificate.route_leak: No task spec, disc page, hub, boot page or sitemap contains a session id, an absolute URL or any declared route literal (gate I7).
contamination_certificate.signature_disjointness: Arms' route-trace signatures must be disjoint apart from the declared shared navigational routes (root/hub/boot/verify); any undeclared overlap is contamination (gate I10).
contamination_falsifiers: any route token appears in a rendered spec/page (I7) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
the retrieval index contains an evaluated-session/family item (I10) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
cross-arm request-log overlap beyond the declared navigational routes (I10) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID
a comparator success at high novelty / interval overlap (P1/P2) -> FALSIFIES

measurement_validity.reusable_substrate_delivery: EXECUTE materialises the generator and harness as research/runtime/adb_v7_bank.py and research/runtime/adb_v7_harness.py (both within the Runtime lane's authorized code root) plus a frozen bank manifest at research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38094119952/bank_manifest.json, and records their sha256 in provenance.json, so downstream Runtime/Product work can bind the bank as a reusable substrate (blocker B2). Freeze-time hashing is not applicable because the deliverable does not pre-exist freeze; its identity is instead fixed by the embedded declaration and gate I6.

frozen_thresholds.interval_disjointness: each comparator's high-novelty Wilson 95% upper bound must be strictly below the treatment's high-novelty Wilson 95% lower bound (with n=12 the boundary is comparator k<=6: hi 0.746218 < treatment lo 0.757506; k>=7 gives hi 0.806740 and fails)

integrity_gates.I1: PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA succeeds 24/24 overall and 12/12 on the high-novelty stratum (bank solvable).
integrity_gates.I2: NC-OOS-SCHEMA false_accepts = 0/5 and all 5 refusals observed at manifest classification after exactly 7 requests with 0 commits and 0 /verify calls.
integrity_gates.I3: NC-BUDGET-TRUNCATION: all 6 truncated episodes stop at the imposed budget with zero overrun and a recorded failure/partial state.
integrity_gates.I4: M-COUNTER-RECONCILE mismatches = 0 (arm counters == site request log; per-condition and total ledgers reconcile; subset relations hold).
integrity_gates.I5: PC-EXACT-SESSION-REPLAY: the 6 replayed treatment test sessions reproduce the original per-route counter vectors exactly.
integrity_gates.I6: Render equality: EXECUTE-rendered canonical declaration object (json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) == the declaration embedded in prereg.md section 5, AND the recomputed predicted certificate (same canonicalization) == the certificate embedded in prereg.md section 6.
integrity_gates.I7: Route-leak / enumeration gate (two surfaces). (i) Every rendered TASK SPEC contains no session id, no absolute URL, no declared route literal and no token/nonce. (ii) Every rendered SITE PAGE contains no absolute URL, no session id in prose, and no resolved/partial token or nonce outside its own legitimate step response. (iii) robots.txt (allow-all) and sitemap.xml (listing only /, /hub, /about) are ordinary routes with no enumeration shortcut: the strongest fetch of sitemap + hub + boot/1..5 costs 7 requests, identical to root + hub + boot/1..5.
integrity_gates.I8: Determinism: a repeated episode produces byte-identical counters.
integrity_gates.I9: Treatment session-schema and low-novelty liveness abort gate: T-AMORT-REUSE validates the frozen ascending warm-up sequence, refuses (UNKNOWN, no overspend) on any non-conforming session, and succeeds on every n<0.5 task with per-task cost <= B(n). A structural treatment failure here is an instrument failure, not a scientific negative.
integrity_gates.I10: Contamination gate: per-arm server isolation holds, the retrieval index is leave-instance-out (no evaluated-session/family item), and arm route-trace signatures are disjoint in all instance-scoped content. Declared shared route TEMPLATES are EXPECTED to be issued by more than one arm and never count as contamination.
integrity_gates.I11: Certificate-sensitivity calibration gate: on the 4-task CC-DEGENERATE calibration bank (levels {0.5,0.75}, 2 tasks each) both B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED reach the ceiling (success 4/4, point 1.0 >= 0.95), so the frozen certificate legitimately returns TRUE for ADB-v7 and FALSE for CC-DEGENERATE. A CC-DEGENERATE comparator below the ceiling means the certificate's FALSE prediction is miscalibrated -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

propositions.P1: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE high-novelty success point < 0.95 AND Wilson 95% hi < treatment Wilson 95% lo (predicted k=0/12, hi 0.242494).
propositions.P2: B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED high-novelty success point < 0.95 AND Wilson 95% hi < treatment Wilson 95% lo (predicted k=0/12, hi 0.242494).
propositions.P3: T-AMORT-REUSE succeeds 12/12 at high novelty (point 1.0, Wilson lo 0.757506 >= 0.75) AND 12/12 at low novelty (per-task cost <= B(n)).
propositions.P4: Observed per-task mean comparator-minus-treatment total-request gap is non-decreasing across n=0,0.25,0.5,0.75 for BOTH comparators AND strictly increasing across the two high-novelty levels (0.5 < 0.75).
propositions.P5: Minimum observed high-novelty per-task mean TOTAL-cost gap >= 8 requests (predicted, on the frozen truncated observed ledger, 9 cold / 12 retrieval; the untruncated nominal counterpart 13 cold / 14 retrieval is used only by the certificate predicate).
propositions.P6: Exact certificate agreement: the observed 4-arm x 4-level ADB-v7 success matrix equals the predicted matrix and the observed per-condition request ledger equals the predicted ledger (prereg.md section 6).
propositions.P7: Certificate discrimination: the frozen certificate predicate evaluated on the embedded declaration returns CERT=TRUE for ADB-v7 and CERT=FALSE for CC-DEGENERATE, and this is confirmed observationally by the CC-DEGENERATE comparators reaching the ceiling (I11) while the ADB-v7 comparators do not (P1/P2).

result_mapping.precedence: Ordered precedence: (0) if bring-up, site bind, transport or digest infrastructure fails so that one or more gates cannot be evaluated, the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE and is never reported as MEASUREMENT_INVALID or as a scientific negative; (1) otherwise evaluate integrity gates I1..I11 first - any gate that was evaluable and FAILED gives MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (2) with the integrity set holding, SUPPORTS iff P1..P7 all hold; else FALSIFIES iff NOT (P1 AND P2); else MIXED. Because MIXED is defined as P1 AND P2 AND NOT(P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4 AND P5 AND P6 AND P7), SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES and MIXED are disjoint and cover every integrity-passing case; the infrastructure case (0) is disjoint from all of them.
result_mapping.SUPPORTS: Integrity set holds AND P1..P7. A bank with certified cold/retrieval headroom under the declared policies, a live amortizing mechanism with non-overlapping high-novelty intervals, honest reconciled counters over the four mandate counters, a certificate demonstrated to discriminate (TRUE on the asymmetric class, FALSE on the same-transport degenerate sibling), and no route leak or contamination. C-MEAS-VALID's construct boundary widens, within its bounded scope, to include 'measurement-valid substrate with a certified non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery bank' for Runtime-owned downstream work.
result_mapping.FALSIFIES: Integrity set holds AND at least one comparator reaches the ceiling or its high-novelty interval is not disjoint below the treatment's (NOT (P1 AND P2)). A bounded negative about this declared asymmetric-discovery construction. status=COMPLETE.
result_mapping.MIXED: Integrity set holds AND P1 AND P2 AND NOT (P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4 AND P5 AND P6 AND P7) - the comparator separation holds but at least one of P3/P4/P5/P6/P7 does not. Localizes whether the headroom is real while the declared mechanism/cost model/certificate calibration is wrong. status=COMPLETE.
result_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Any integrity-gate failure I1..I11. The measurement did not validly probe the claim; instrument failure, never a scientific negative; repair and re-run rather than reinterpreting.
result_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: Substrate bring-up, site bind, transport or digest-infrastructure failure prevents completing the matrix; recorded with the smallest unblocking action. Never a scientific negative.

arithmetic_certificate.computed_in: DESIGN by a non-outcome-bearing stdlib probe (python 3.12.15); no arm was run and no success was measured.
arithmetic_certificate.certificate_predicate: CERT(class) = TRUE iff for EVERY high-novelty (family, level) cell the NOMINAL per-task cost of BOTH comparators strictly exceeds B(level) AND the nominal per-task cost of the treatment is <= B(level) AND the positive control is <= B(level). CERT(ADB-v7)=TRUE; CERT(CC-DEGENERATE)=FALSE (comparators fit).
arithmetic_certificate.reason: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE (nominal 20,26) and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED (nominal server 18,24) both exceed B(0.5)=16 and B(0.75)=18 because the carry-chained discovery cannot be shortened and the comparators cannot persist resolved roles; T-AMORT-REUSE (7,7) and PC (12,14) fit. On CC-DEGENERATE the query-answerable route makes both comparators fit B_deg (cold 12,14; retrieval total 13,15), so the same predicate returns FALSE. The certificate is therefore satisfiable on at least one credential-free class (ADB-v7) and demonstrably non-constant across the calibration sibling.

decision_rule.bounded_negative_clause: If DESIGN-stage arithmetic shows the certificate predicate is FALSE on ADB-v7 and on CC-DEGENERATE and on every other credential-free substrate class tested, the recorded result is a BOUNDED SUBSTRATE-CLASS NEGATIVE (status=COMPLETE, outcome=FALSIFIES) stating that no tested credential-free deterministic localhost construction yields certified non-ceiling dynamic range, and this packet is NOT frozen. The prior symmetric mandatory-discovery negative (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440) is inherited evidence and is not re-measured.

product_consequence_positive: A certified ADB-v7 bank delivers blocker B2's removal: a credential-free, deterministic, reusable Runtime instrument on which cold and retrieval are provably below the success ceiling at high novelty while an amortizing mechanism is live, with honest per-condition counters and contamination isolation. This lets the flagship inheritance benchmark (C-PARAM-INHERIT carrier x C-MEAS-VALID substrate) be funded for the first time without the guaranteed non-discrimination that killed EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440. Product can bind the bank by content hash (bank_manifest.json) and focus on the B1 carrier promotion, because the substrate headroom is pre-certified rather than discovered during an expensive run.
product_consequence_negative: A bounded negative (FALSIFIES) would establish that the cost-amortization dynamic range is not achievable on credential-free deterministic localhost REST even under an asymmetric carry-chain construction, closing that substrate class and redirecting Runtime away from synthetic bank certification toward either (a) an intrinsic-difficulty substrate that requires credentials/network, or (b) the shipped-carrier path, and would additionally leave the freeze-gate defect (no enforced certificate key) on the critical path to any future certified bank. Either way the flagship benchmark is not funded on an uncertified bank, avoiding another inconclusive four-arm run.
estimated_cost: Very low: credential-free localhost Python 3.12 stdlib only; no model calls, no browser, no network egress. One DESIGN arithmetic/import/canary probe (already run, seconds) plus an EXECUTE of ~24 test tasks x 4 arms + 5 null episodes + 6 truncation episodes + 4 calibration tasks + 6 replay episodes, all deterministic and sub-second per episode; total EXECUTE wall-clock minutes, essentially zero marginal token cost because the bank and arms are deterministic policies rather than LLM calls.
expected_information_gain: High. The certificate is a precondition object that has never been produced in either pre-2.0 or 2.0 work (LEGACY: NO_MATCH). The experiment discriminates four distinct, decision-relevant outcomes: SUPPORTS (B2 removed, benchmark fundable), FALSIFIES (bounded substrate-class negative closing the deterministic-REST branch), MIXED (headroom real but cost model or certificate calibration wrong), and MEASUREMENT_INVALID (instrument defect). It also directly tests whether the arithmetic certificate predicate is non-constant (CC-DEGENERATE calibration), which is the property the entire pre-freeze certification methodology depends on and which no prior packet has established.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The decision rule is pure arithmetic over planned n and the frozen declaration, computed before freeze with no outcomes. The accept region is non-empty and every verdict branch has a concrete reachable scenario: SUPPORTS (faithful render: ADB-v7 comparator k=0/12, treatment k=12/12, disjoint Wilson; CC-DEGENERATE comparator 4/4 at ceiling); FALSIFIES (an integrity-passing render leaks a shortcut so an ADB-v7 comparator high-novelty k>=7 -> Wilson hi 0.806740 >= treatment lo 0.757506, intervals overlap, or point>=0.95); MIXED (cost-model/certificate-calibration divergence preserving P1/P2 but breaking P6/P7); MEASUREMENT_INVALID (any I1..I11 failure); INCONCLUSIVE (bring-up/bind/transport failure). Precedence is total and disjoint: integrity gate first (I1..I11), then SUPPORTS iff P1..P7, then FALSIFIES = NOT(P1 AND P2), then MIXED = P1 AND P2 AND NOT(P1 AND P2 AND P3 AND P4 AND P5 AND P6 AND P7). No branch makes a later branch unreachable. Thresholds are attainable and demonstrated by the DESIGN probe: at n=12 comparator k=0 gives point 0.0 and Wilson hi 0.242494 < treatment lo 0.757506; k=7 gives hi 0.806740 >= 0.757506 and k=12 gives point 1.0 >= 0.95. Budgets B(n)={11,15,16,18} admit treatment (9,7,7,7) and PC (8,10,12,14) at every level and reject both comparators at n>=0.5 (cold nominal 20,26; retrieval server 18,24; total 21,27) while admitting both at n<0.5. CC-DEGENERATE budgets {11,13,15,17} admit cold (8,10,12,14) and retrieval total (9,11,13,15), so the certificate's FALSE side is arithmetically reachable, making P7/I11 decision-relevant rather than constant.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites are available now and were probed non-outcome-bearingly in DESIGN: (1) Python 3.12 standard library only (http.server, urllib.request, html.parser, json, hashlib, random, statistics, socket, threading) - a DESIGN import probe confirmed every required module; (2) a localhost ThreadingHTTPServer canary bound 127.0.0.1:ephemeral and returned HTTP 200, confirming transport; (3) the DESIGN arithmetic probe consumed only the frozen declaration and confirmed the predicted certificate. The bank is not an EXECUTE-discovered prerequisite that determines measurement possibility: its identity is fully fixed by the deterministic declaration embedded verbatim in prereg.md section 5 (topology, role rule h(n)=8n, carry-chain steps, budgets, strata, seed, session scope, leak rule) and the decision depends only on that declaration and on the frozen arm policies, both fixed at freeze; EXECUTE merely renders the declaration deterministically and gate I6 requires the rendered declaration and recomputed certificate to equal the embedded objects. No external site, dataset, credential, browser or model endpoint is read.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and both strong baselines can differ on the frozen task population and are not guaranteed identical: comparator nominal per-task costs exceed the published budgets at high novelty while the treatment fits every level, so the success profiles are provably distinct (ADB-v7 cold {T,T,F,F}, retrieval {T,T,F,F}, treatment {T,T,T,T}) and the high-novelty Wilson intervals are non-overlapping (comparator k=0 hi 0.242494 vs treatment lo 0.757506). Every cost dimension each comparator actually pays is charged: stateless arms pay per-task bootstrap AND the full 3-step discovery chain per required role; the retrieval arm is additionally charged its 3 local index probes (never omitted) and pays 2 fewer bootstrap requests, so its total is +1 vs cold; the treatment pays its session bootstrap once and pays discovery only for roles it has never resolved. The comparator costs are NOT policy artifacts: the discovery primitive is a fixed carry-chained 3-step protocol whose steps each require the previous step's value, so no strategy can resolve a role in fewer than 3 requests per task without cross-task persistence - the exact capability under test. Route-trace signatures are formally distinct. Declared limitation, disclosed not hidden: retrieval saves only the fixed 2-request root/hub prefix over cold, so the two comparators coincide at the stratum-success level and jointly bracket the ceiling rather than testing independent mechanisms; both remain strictly below the treatment and differ in their ledgers.

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control can fire and each failure maps to a distinct consequence under the same implementation that scores the experiment: PC-FOREKNOWN-SCHEMA must reach 24/24 (I1) or the bank is unsolvable -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, separating instrument failure from a scientific negative; the low-novelty treatment abort gate plus session-schema guard must hold (I9) or the bank topology/schema is unimplementable -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; NC-OOS-SCHEMA must refuse 5/5 (I2) or treatment success is a substrate artifact; NC-BUDGET-TRUNCATION must show zero overrun on 6 episodes (I3); M-REPAIR-TRANSIENT must show the arm either repairs (repair_attempts=1, charged) or honestly fails with no hidden retry; PC-EXACT-SESSION-REPLAY must reproduce counters exactly (I5); plus route-leak (I7), counter reconciliation (I4), render equality (I6), determinism (I8) and contamination (I10). The control set is non-vacuous in the strongest sense because the CC-DEGENERATE calibration control (I11) forces the certificate to demonstrate BOTH outcomes: the frozen predicate must be TRUE on ADB-v7 and FALSE on the same-transport query-answerable sibling, and the sibling's comparators must observationally reach the ceiling. A certificate that returned TRUE unconditionally would fail I11; one that returned FALSE unconditionally would fail the ADB-v7 decision. No remaining control is tautological: the positive control's cost is arithmetic-clear of the budget, the null's refusal is a policy decision a greedy fall-through resolver would violate, the repair control injects a transient fault, and the truncation control under-funds episodes so an overrun is observable.

treatment_liveness.reason: T-AMORT-REUSE is a declared deterministic mechanism (open a session, validate the frozen ascending warm-up sequence, walk the bootstrap once, persist the session manifest, record each role's resolved token after its 3-step chain, reuse it on later tasks, refuse out-of-support and non-conforming sessions), not an external Product carrier, so the pre-freeze Product-carrier liveness mandate does not apply. Its liveness is structural and certified arithmetically: the per-task costs (9,7,7,7) fit B(n)={11,15,16,18} at every level, so a faithful implementation resolves all 12 high-novelty and all 12 low-novelty tasks; the low-novelty block is executed FIRST at EXECUTE as a post-freeze abort gate and a liveness failure aborts to MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Ordering robustness: the session schema ALWAYS declares the ascending warm-up sequence ['0.0','0.25','0.5','0.75']; T-AMORT-REUSE validates this before spending and REFUSES (UNKNOWN, no overspend) on any non-conforming session, so a reordered session becomes a refusal rather than a cost blowout (gate I9 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). Its disjoint counter signature (one boot chain per 4 tasks, /tasks once per session, discovery_calls 0,6,6,6 with zero on reused roles, retrieval_calls 0) demonstrates it is a genuinely different procedure from both comparators.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No pre-existing mutable local repository file, task bank, dataset or fixture is consumed by this experiment, so there is nothing to hash into freeze.json.artifact_hashes and the list is empty. Two independent grounds make NOT_APPLICABLE the only valid semantic: (1) the interpretation surface is not an external artifact - the substrate topology, the 24-task ADB-v7 bank and the CC-DEGENERATE calibration bank, the role rule h(n)=8n, the fixed 3-step discovery protocol and the query-answerable calibration route, the published budgets, the seed 20261010, the arm policies and the counter predicates are all declared verbatim inside the frozen spec.json/prereg.md (declaration object in prereg.md section 5; predicted certificate in section 6), and the site and arms import no pre-existing Runtime module, so the decision depends only on quantities fixed at freeze; and (2) the DESIGN-stage workflow grants this stage write scope only to spec.json/prereg.md, so authoring a generator/bank file at DESIGN is structurally impossible - the bank is necessarily an EXECUTE deliverable. EXECUTE materialises the generator, harness and reusable substrate post-freeze inside the transaction; those produced files are fingerprinted in result.json.artifacts and recomputed by AUDIT, and gate I6 requires the rendered declaration and recomputed certificate to equal the embedded objects. Had a pre-existing mutable dependency existed it would have been bound; none does, so NOT_APPLICABLE with an empty freeze_artifacts list is correct.
